headline: Binance Links $6.3 Billion Crypto Theft to North Korean Social Engineering
summary: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance reported that a theft of $6.3 billion in crypto assets stemmed from sophisticated social engineering attacks involving fake job interviews and artificial intelligence.
why: Binance is one of the world's largest cryptocurrency exchanges, and major security breaches highlight operational risks and regulatory scrutiny across the digital asset sector.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Major exchange security incidents can depress broad crypto market sentiment and token values.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The revelation of a massive multi-billion-dollar exploit executed via advanced social engineering raises investor concerns regarding exchange security and systemic vulnerabilities in crypto holdings.
